about_the_game:
Depths of Apollyon is a third-person action RPG set in a decaying, post-apocalyptic medieval world governed by an ancient AI.

Master fast-paced combat with sword, greatsword, and bow. Chain parkour moves through vertical ruins and shifting halls. Swap between modular gear that alters your playstyle, and fight your way through corrupted beasts, synthetic horrors, and biomechanical bosses.

Explore ruined temples, cybernetic labs, and forgotten villages, each stitched together by Apollyon's fractured mind. Every step forward uncovers echoes of past experiments — and the chance to change fate.

Will you free the machine… or become another failed subject?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
